state.title: naoqi_rest

content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
I found the red ball and stopped about 25 cm in front of it, facing it. The robot is now resting.

My last look at the ball was with the head tilted down. It showed the ball close and about centered. The final `rest` command moved the robot's heading a little (odometry theta went from -1.10 to -1.26 rad), so it may be slightly off-center now. I didn't check the ball's position after that.
